verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a Bounce API to "Manage bounced emails and reactivate addresses," so the product itself offers API-level reading and management of hard bounces. The evidence does not mention a suppression-list API for spam complaints or unsubscribes, and the docs are only brief index entries. missing for 10: documented suppression-list endpoints covering complaints and unsubscribes, detail on listing and deleting suppressions per stream, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can read and manage bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppression lists via the API so my app never re-emails a hard bounce
